July 14, 2026

Ryan Farris PR

* * *

BDR founder Bruce Wiseman will remain with the company, transitioning into the role of Executive Chairman.

# BDR Appoints Ryan Farris CEO as Founder Bruce Wiseman Becomes Executive Chairman

July 14, 2026

Ryan Farris

[**Business Development Resources**](https://www.bdrco.com/) (BDR) has appointed **Ryan Farris** as chief executive officer, marking a leadership transition at the business coaching and training firm serving home service contractors across North America. Founder **Bruce Wiseman** will remain with the company as executive chairman.
Farris assumes the CEO role effective immediately, bringing more than 30 years of leadership experience across entrepreneurship, technology, marketing and business operations. The appointment comes as BDR continues expanding its coaching, training and marketing services for contractors, distributors and platform companies in the home services industry.

The leadership change reflects a broader trend in the home services sector, where growing contractor businesses are increasingly seeking operational guidance, leadership development and financial management support to navigate expansion, labor shortages and evolving customer expectations.

Wiseman said selecting a successor was one of the company’s most important long-term decisions, adding that Farris emerged from an extensive search process as the right leader to build on BDR’s culture and mission.

Farris joins BDR after a career that has combined corporate leadership with entrepreneurship.
After spending more than a decade in executive roles, he founded and grew his own company before successfully exiting the business. Over the past 10 years, he has focused on coaching entrepreneurs and small business owners, helping them develop strategies for sustainable growth and operational improvement.

His background closely aligns with BDR’s focus on helping contractors strengthen profitability, leadership and business performance through coaching, marketing, financial management and professional development programs.

Commenting on his appointment, Farris said he was drawn to the company’s longstanding reputation and mission of helping business owners succeed. He said his priorities include building on BDR’s existing foundation, expanding the company’s reach and supporting more contractors as they grow their businesses.
Founded in **1998** by **Bruce Wiseman** and **Barry Burnett** , BDR has become a well-established provider of business development services for the home services industry. The company works with contractors across HVAC, plumbing, electrical and other skilled trades, offering business coaching, marketing support, accounting and financial guidance, and employee training programs.

Today, BDR supports **more than 900 contractor businesses** through its Profit Coach and Marketing Services programs. The company also reports that more than **10,000 businesses** participate in its training events annually, while nearly **1,000 business leaders** attend its Profit Launch workshops each year to develop growth strategies.

As executive chairman, Wiseman will continue working with the leadership team, clients and industry partners while helping guide the company’s long-term strategic direction.
The executive transition positions BDR to continue expanding its presence in the growing home services market, where contractors are increasingly investing in business coaching, operational systems and workforce development to improve profitability and compete in an industry undergoing continued consolidation and professionalization.

### Bertrand Schmitt appointed new CEO of BDR Thermea Group

BDR Thermea Group, parent company of Baxi Heating UK and Ireland, has announced the appointment of Bertrand Schmitt as its new CEO.

15 March 2017

bertrand schmitt Mr Schmitt will assume responsibilities on 18 April 2017. He succeeds Rob van Banning, who led the company successfully for a decade but unfortunately had to step down for health reasons at the end of 2016.

"I am honoured and excited to have been selected to lead BDR Thermea Group”, commented Bertrand Schmitt after the announcement. "We're delighted that Bertrand has accepted the position”, added Arthur van der Poel, Chairman of BDR Thermea Groups's Supervisory Board.
"Bertrand has been a successful executive at Hager Group for more than 20 years and - at least as important - we believe he is a great fit to our values and culture at BDR Thermea Group."

Bertrand Schmitt (1959) graduated at Karlsruhe University and has held senior management positions at Bosch and, since 1995, at Hager Group. In 2008 he was appointed COO at Hager Group and has contributed to the growth of the business worldwide. He has dual French and German nationality.
